bear.point: EBITDA margin fell 6.1 pp YoY to 33.4%, compressing earnings power despite revenue growth.
15% growth promise missed as FY26 revenue grew only 11.64%, indicating slower-than-targeted expansion.
PAT declined 0.3% YoY despite 18.1% revenue growth, showing severe operating leverage failure.
Operating cash flow at 0.79x PAT reveals weak cash conversion, trapping capital in receivables.

bull.point: Revenue grew 18.1% YoY, demonstrating significant top-line expansion and market share gains.
Debt/equity improved to 0.02 from 0.03, strengthening the balance sheet and financial flexibility.
EBITDA margin remains high at 33.4%, preserving substantial profitability despite recent compression.
Analysts probe deep moats beyond ticketing, suggesting potential for defensible, hard-to-copy business models.
